goal: For independently evidenced child invocations in the analyzed log cohort, attain the declared explicit model size, demonstrated by uniquely bound protected child/proxy records.
nativeQuantity: Correct resolution share in percent, with separately retained verified-correct child-invocation subtotal.
eligiblePopulation: Independently evidenced actual child invocations in the source's bounded analyzed sample. An stdio regex match alone is not an invocation. Missing source/model/binding evidence remains unassessed.
evidenceAcceptance: Run, attempt, final retry session, child identity and tool-call identity agree; declaration is bound to immutable source; independent proxy records identify that child's concrete served models. All served requests must match for correctness; a wrong request establishes a mismatch without erasing other verified children.

sourceProfiles.adoption: Codex parent gpt-5-mini, inline run-analyzer model small; original source includes noop-reminder runtime import.
sourceProfiles.current: Copilot SDK parent gpt-5.4-mini, inline run-analyzer model gpt-5.4-mini; reporting is imported.
sourceProfiles.sharedPredicate: Both workflow prose profiles contain the same case-insensitive mini/haiku/flash/nano size predicate.
sourceProfiles.notHistoricalApproval: Two endpoint profiles do not establish unchanged intermediate policy, native producer identity or retained request coverage. Current predicate remains restricted to its frozen current profile.

temporal.sourceBasis: Workflow audits recent two-day log cohorts. Production observationWindows partitions delivery rather than adding overlapping daily two-day audits.
temporal.event: One underlying child invocation keyed by run/attempt/session/agent/tool-call identity, never one issue or audit rerun.
temporal.partial: Unknown broader acceptance does not erase established correct-child subtotals. No retained native events currently exist.
